translations./jobs/0/blurb: Deliver town mail. Conserve power—the operator at the town plant judges this job by energy use.
translations./jobs/1/blurb: Deliver a medical kit. Fragile cargo needs clearance; slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
translations./jobs/2/blurb: Deliver seed grain. The town needs it quickly, but a collision still costs reputation.
translations./jobs/3/blurb: Deliver machine parts. Conserve power—the operator at the town plant judges this job by energy use.
translations./jobs/4/blurb: Deliver clean water. Fragile cargo needs clearance; slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
